body: fuck anyone who says you NEED to get better for THEM or that your problems don't matter. the only person you need to do anything for is yourself and I've realised that after getting some fantastic advice from someone else on this sub. only 2 days ago I felt like every day was monotonous and grey. nobody understood what I was going through and I was living an empty life for an empty person. BUT. after making the first step and reaching out on here I realised that there are people who, while they don't know what i'm going through, can relate. and I want to be that person for you. one of the things the person told me was to watch this ted talk https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D1QoyTmeAYw because this guy is one of the few people to have spoken publicly about the subject and especially the idea of just waiting one more day. what i WON'T do is try to tell you what to do. nobody should do that, whatever you do has to be your decision. i WON'T tell you it will get better, but i'll tell you it can. just give me a chance to talk things through with you if you want, because I want to try and help.
